name: player_start_destroyed_state_vehicle_effect
description: Player::StartDestroyedStateVehicleEffect selects the destroyed-state vehicle effect, clears recent-hit light feedback, installs an optional completion callback, and hides the tracked HUD progress meter.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player combat/effect source-cluster pass because the byte shape depends on neighboring Player state layout, zEffect activation helpers, and class-context codegen.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43c0c0 validates the fastcall save-state and callback ABI, the effect selection priority for queued fixed damage, damage protection, recent hit, AI/sub transition, and default destroyed respawn, the zero-velocity zEffectAnim::SetVelocity_Thunk call, recent-hit light cleanup through zEffect_Anim::NodeActionCallback, optional SetOnStateDoneCallback, and the HudUiMgr::HideTrackedProgressMeterIfOwnerMatches call.

The native smoke exercises all five selector branches, verifies the async handle and zero velocity on the selected effect, verifies recent-hit state and light-handle cleanup, verifies callback/context installation, and verifies the HUD progress-meter hide dispatch for a matching tracked slot owner.
